maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are arranged in a horizontal linear series, separated from the primary dense row below by a vertical distance approximately twice the diameter of a single keypoint cluster.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 95% melanin saturation, with deep black pigmentation across the dorsal and lateral surfaces; a minor pale/pink region is localized to the lower central apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, distinct dark focal point (potential lesion or scar) is present on the left frontal region of the forehead, superior to the orbital ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white pelage on the sub-mandibular region; distinct dark-pigmented borders visible on the superior margins of the pinnae.
